description:
`PackedFpMatrix::matvec_packed` in `crates/gf2-core/src/gfp/simd_ops.rs` uses a row-panel kernel for small primes only; medium primes take the generic path.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `matvec_packed` runs medium primes through a row-panel kernel whose results equal the scalar matvec on the shared field-matrix suite, with the scalar fallback retained.
- [aspirational] REQ-02: A committed receipt from an uncontended host compares the two paths under the repository's benchmark protocol.
title: Row-panel matvec for the medium-prime packed kernel
